name: generative-view
title: Generative View
description: A closed vocabulary of blocks — cards, fields, tables, lists, timelines, stats, progress, tabs, buttons and forms — drawn from JSON an agent writes in a ```ui fence, progressively as it streams, or read off a tool's JSON output by shape alone. Buttons and forms send a message back through onAction. Data, never code: normalized, bounded, safe links only. Ships VIEW_SPEC_PROMPT, the vocabulary for a model in ~200 tokens.
